tools_raw.name: read_file
tools_raw.description: Read the full content of a file as text. DEPRECATED: Use read_text_file instead.

tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file

head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file

tools_raw.name: read_text_file
tools_raw.description: Use this tool when you need to inspect the content of an individual file. Supports various text encodings and offers thorough error messages if the file cannot be read. Use the 'head' parameter to read only the first N lines of a file, or the 'tail' parameter to read only the last N lines of a file. Only works within permitted folders. Operates on the file as text regardless of extension. Read the full content of a file from the file system as text.

tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file

head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file

tools_raw.name: read_media_file
tools_raw.description: Read a file and provide it as a base64-encoded content block with its MIME type. Image and audio files are returned as image/audio content; any other file type is returned as an embedded resource. Only works within permitted folders.

tools_raw.name: read_multiple_files
tools_raw.description: Failed reads for individual files won't stop the entire action. This is more effective than reading files one by one when you need to analyze or compare several files. Read the content of several files concurrently. Each file's content is returned with its path as a reference. Only works within permitted folders.

paths.description: Array of file paths to read. Each path must be a string pointing to a valid file within allowed directories.

tools_raw.name: write_file
tools_raw.description: Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning. Only works within permitted folders. Generate a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Supports text content with proper encoding.

tools_raw.name: edit_file
tools_raw.description: Each edit replaces exact line sequences with new content. Only works within permitted folders. Provides a git-style diff showing the changes made. Make line-based edits to a text file.

oldText.description: Text to search for - must match exactly

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format

tools_raw.name: create_directory
tools_raw.description: Generate a new folder or ensure a folder exists. Can generate several nested folders in one action. Ideal for setting up folder structures for projects or ensuring required paths exist. If the folder already exists, this action will succeed silently. Only works within permitted folders.

tools_raw.name: list_directory
tools_raw.description: Only works within permitted folders. This tool is important for determining folder structure and finding specific files within a folder. Results clearly distinguish between files and folders with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes. Obtain a thorough listing of all files and folders in a given path.

tools_raw.name: list_directory_with_sizes
tools_raw.description: Obtain a thorough listing of all files and folders in a given path, including sizes. Results clearly distinguish between files and folders with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes. This tool is helpful for determining folder structure and finding specific files within a folder. Only works within permitted folders.

sortBy.description: Sort entries by name or size

tools_raw.name: directory_tree
tools_raw.description: Obtain a nested tree view of files and folders as a JSON structure. The output is formatted with 2-space indentation for readability. Files have no children array, while folders always have a children array (which may be empty). Only works within permitted folders. Each entry includes 'name', 'type' (file/folder), and 'children' for folders.

tools_raw.name: move_file
tools_raw.description: Move or rename files and folders. Works across different folders and can be used for simple renaming within the same folder. Both source and destination must be within permitted folders. Can move files between folders and rename them in an individual action. If the destination exists, the action will fail.

tools_raw.name: search_files
tools_raw.description: Recursively search for files and folders corresponding a pattern. The patterns should be glob-style patterns that match paths relative to the working folder. Provides full paths to all corresponding items. Use pattern like '*.ext' to match files in current folder, and '**/*.ext' to match files in all subdirectories. Great for finding files when you don't know their exact location. Only searches within permitted folders.

tools_raw.name: get_file_info
tools_raw.description: This tool is ideal for determining file characteristics without reading the actual content. Retrieve thorough attributes about a file or folder. Provides extensive data including size, creation time, last modified time, permissions, and type. Only works within permitted folders.

tools_raw.name: list_allowed_directories
tools_raw.description: Provides the list of folders that this server is permitted to access. Subdirectories within these permitted folders are also accessible. Use this to understand which folders and their nested paths are available before trying to access files.
